reason: PlanEncode writes no output and cannot in general know all exact future JPEG/compressed/native output hashes. The source semantics/layout/coverage are immutable before encode; exact actual bytes must be bound after they exist. Output hashes never redefine the expected source content.

sourceExpectation.when: Before Consent/EncodeApproved, Engine independently captures full immutable source and registers SourceExpectation under the existing planId with LossBinding, complete source ledger, expected transitive reference effects/optional outcomes, per-object source content and proposed output owner locators, per-leaf comparison bundle, all required artifact roles/keys and destination/layout/options.
sourceExpectation.objects: requiredObjectKeys must equal exactly once the sourceObjectKey set in requiredObjects. These objects come from independent source capture before lossy EncodeInventory or encoder projection. The encoder cannot remove a source field, raw thermal table, optional-present geometry effect or owner by redefining this set.
sourceExpectation.bytes: ArtifactRole has no future outputSHA or invented zero-byte default. For source-copied immutable resources a separately bound source hash can already be known; generated bytes are not presumed deterministic. Role/key/owner/reference closure and valid encoding policy must nevertheless be fully planned.

candidateBinding.when: After actual private candidate bytes have been produced, trusted capture reads every actual candidate file/stream and binds its key/SHA/length in CandidateArtifactBinding to the already registered SourceExpectation digest. This step confers no semantic validity or Saved authority.
candidateBinding.coverage: Actual published file-key set equals independently planned required artifact roles. Missing required or unexpected referenced files fail; owned intermediate/unreferenced scratch files are excluded from publication and cleaned only when unreachable. Names and implicit-pair relations still satisfy resource-graph/output-layout rules.
candidateBinding.immutability: A new candidate byte set creates a different binding/verifier context, with the same prior source expectation only if source/options/layout/loss/consent truly unchanged. Source-semantic changes need new planId/consent, not an artifact rebind. Late changed source cannot borrow old binding.

validation.prepublish: Independently resolve every actual primary/nested explicit/implicit reference from CandidateArtifactBinding-owned bytes. Compare expected effects/objects/source/precision with SourceExpectation and ComparisonBundle; byte hashes are comparison inputs, not the pass criterion. Same correct grid bytes but no Field remains E_REOPEN_COVERAGE.
validation.postpublish: Capture and compare the real persisted file set under actual host authority, then independently verify full registered source semantics. Candidate result reuse requires identical actual input bytes/rules/provenance. Changed bytes or missing table/field refuse Saved; publication-possible outcomes remain committed-unverified/unknown.
validation.laterLoad: Ordinary future load doesnot require a prior in-RAM plan. Reconstruct source effects from qualified persisted primary/resource/metadata and independent parse. Capture source semantics and actual artifact identity before exposing completeLoaded; do not use old process caches.

integration.exactOldExample: resource-reopen.schema.json/finite witness retain their exact known-artifact SaveExpectation example unchanged. In a real pipeline that exact artifact identity is a candidate-stage binding, while its semantic source objects were independently registered earlier. Do not interpret the finite example registration as proof that PlanEncode predicts compressed bytes.
integration.newNonexact: resource-content-comparison handles actual source-versus-output numeric content under an immutable prior budget. The actual artifact-set digest is registered after candidate creation; decoder input isolation and immutable expected source access remain separate.
integration.protocol: These new closed values are internal design proposals. Existing protocol3/old sealed messages not extended or admitted. Actual transport migration belongs a versioned implementation card, not silent extra fields.
